fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/UtilityPages/BodyMakers.cy.js#UtilityPages - BodyMakers [en] — Body Makers TC-BDM-01: Talk To Dealer lead submits successfully on Body Makers
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-BDM-01
**Title:** Talk To Dealer lead submits successfully on Body Makers
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the Body Makers page, click a dealer card's "Talk To Dealer" button to open its lead form, fill name, mobile, city, brand and model, and submit.

**Expected Result:**
A Thank You confirmation is shown after a successful lead submission.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Body Makers page
2. Click a dealer card's "Talk To Dealer" button to open its lead form
3. Fill name, mobile, city, brand and model
4. Submit and verify Thank You confirmation
